objectives: Ensure an environment where all students feel safe and secure
Provide prompt counselling for emotional emergencies arising from any campus event
Provide a mechanism to redress student grievances

women_grievance_redressal_committee.also_known_as: Grievance Redressal Committee for Women cum Anti Sexual Harassment
women_grievance_redressal_committee.purpose: Offers suggestions to management on matters connected with women's welfare (transport, canteen facilities, and other issues); handles complaints/grievances of teaching and non-teaching female staff.
functions: Address problems and complaints of female staff and redress grievances as early as possible
Keep the Principal and management informed from time to time about grievances raised by female staff
women_grievance_redressal_committee.note: Committee members meet as and when the need arises and forward recommendations to the Principal and management for further action.

escalation_note: For grievance or harassment-related queries, the agent should always direct students to the relevant committee/chairperson contact above rather than attempting to resolve or advise on the complaint itself.
